title: Gas Safe Register UK Scraper Input

location.title: Search Location (City or Postcode)
location.description: Enter a UK postcode or town/city name to search (e.g., 'Leeds', 'SW1A 1AA', 'Manchester', 'London').

serviceType.title: Service Type
serviceType.description: Filter by gas service type (Domestic or Commercial).

maxPages.title: Max Business Result Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of business listing pages to scrape. Keeping this low conserves Apify compute & proxy credits.

includeEngineers.title: Collect Engineers & Qualifications
includeEngineers.description: If enabled, visits each business detail page to collect registered engineer names and qualification tables. Disabling this runs much faster and uses fewer requests.

engineerPagesPerBusiness.title: Max Engineer Pages per Business
engineerPagesPerBusiness.description: Maximum pages of engineer records to scrape per business. Default is 2 to keep runs lightweight.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select Apify Proxy. UK Residential Proxy is required because gassaferegister.co.uk enforces UK geo-restrictions and Imperva bot protection.
